label: Bible Study
prompt: I will _____ and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verse: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
note: The prodigal's rehearsed speech, worked out while feeding pigs in a far country.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging _____.
verse: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
note: David, now old, looks back: in a whole lifetime he never saw the righteous forsaken.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and _____ which she did.
verse: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
note: Dorcas was known for good works and almsdeeds — including the coats and garments the widows showed Peter.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, _____ all things.
verse: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
note: Love's four 'all things' — and the last one, endurance, keeps going after the other three get tired.

label: Don't Play With Me
verse: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
note: 'Abstain from all appearance of evil' — one of the shortest commands in Paul's rapid-fire closing list.
